inputs.user_query: Can I turn left on red from a one-way street?

expectations.standalone_question: Can I turn left on red from a one-way street?
expectations.reference_answer: Yes, you may turn left against a red light when you are turning from a one-way street onto a one-way street.
reference_contexts: ### Left Turn Against a Red Light You may turn left against a red light when you are turning from a one-way street onto a one-way street. Make sure there is no sign prohibiting the turn. Yield to other vehicles, pedestrians, or bicyclists who have a green light. Look both ways and turn when it is safe.
